function.name: get_stock_price
function.description: Look up by a company ticker, then get the current stock price.

function.name: get_ipo_info
function.description: Look up IPO information by stock ticker symbol.

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol, e.g., 'AAPL', 'LOT', or 'ZK'

function.name: company_profile
function.description: Retrieve a public company's profile using a stock ticker symbol, including company name, ticker, country, currency, exchange, industry, IPO date, market capitalization, shares outstanding, website, phone number, and logo URL.

symbol.description: The stock ticker symbol, e.g., 'AAPL', 'LOT', or 'ZK'

function.name: company_news
function.description: Get recent company news headlines and summaries by stock ticker symbol over a date range.

symbol.description: The stock ticker symbol, e.g., 'AAPL', 'LOT', or 'ZK'

from_date.description: Optional start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to_date.description: Optional end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

limit.description: Maximum number of news items to return.

function.name: basic_financials
function.description: Get company basic financials, including snapshot metrics such as eps, margin, enterprise value, P/E ratio, past-52-week stock price high/low etc; and annual/quaterly metrics

metric.description: Metric type. Can be 1 of the following values: all(here means 'all' is the only availible value of this parameter til now)

function.name: stock_snapshot
function.description: Get a compact stock market snapshot by stock ticker symbol, including current price, one-month move, market cap, PE, and 52-week range.

symbol.description: The stock ticker symbol, e.g., 'AAPL', 'LOT', or 'ZK'

function.name: price_history
function.description: Get historical OHLCV price data from Yahoo Finance by stock ticker symbol.

symbol.description: The stock ticker symbol, e.g., 'AAPL', 'LOT', or 'ZK'
